items.title: Introducing Predator VPN
items.description: Refreshed branding and updated light and dark logos throughout the app.

items.title: Personalized appearance
items.description: Choose from ten accent colors, including orange by default and gold, with your choice saved securely.

items.title: Resilient proxy session authentication
items.description: When a temporary proxy pass is rejected, the client attempts a fresh pass and retries the request without immediately tearing down the VPN.

items.title: Android-specific controls
items.description: A refined phone layout and a dedicated monochrome icon for the Android Quick Settings tile.

items.title: Updates and accounts preserved
items.description: Existing installation identities and securely saved account data remain compatible with the new brand.
